description: 01058135_BP_102_Zum_Hafen_West_1 is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by GDI-DE. Der Bebauungsplan (B-Plan) 01058135BP102ZumHafenWest1 wurde digital aufbereitet. Er bildet nach Satzungsbeschluss die Festsetzungen für die städtebauliche Ordnung ab und stellt Teile der verbindlichen Bauleitplanung der Gebietskörperschaft Stadt Rendsburg dar. Das amtliche Dokument mit den rechtsverbindlichen Festsetzungen ist bei der zuständigen Stelle hinterlegt. Coverage: GDI-DE. The portal files it under the publisher GDI-DE. Its tags are bauleitplan, bauleitplanung, opendata, raumplanung, xplanung. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/GML. The portal shows 2026-09-14 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
